sloka: पत्नीभिः सन्तु काकुत्स्था मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ।जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पाणीन् पाणिभिः अस्पृशन् ॥१-७३-३४॥
transliteration: patnībhiḥ santu kākutsthā mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ ।janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā pāṇīn pāṇibhiḥ aspṛśan ॥1-73-34॥

translations.english: O Descendants of Kakustha (Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata and Satrughna) you all are gentle. You possess sound character. You are true to your vows. Live with your wives. Let there be no delay".
